articles.summary: AI agent 技能：围绕任意话题检索 Reddit、X、YouTube、Hacker News、Polymarket 与网页的最新信息，再汇总成有出处支撑的摘要。适合舆情追踪、选题调研与市场速览等场景。

articles.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
articles.excerpt: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
articles.summary: Google Labs 推出的 Agent Skills 库，配合 Stitch MCP server 使用，每个技能遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，兼容 Gemini CLI、Claude Code 等编码代理。适合想复用统一技能格式做 agent 开发的团队。

articles.title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
articles.excerpt: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 125 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 117 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
articles.summary: 移动应用上架的开放手册与提审前自查工具，收录 125 种 App Store 与 Google Play 常见拒审模式及修复方案，并检查隐私清单与 Data safety 填报。适合 iOS/Android 开发者在提交前避免被拒。

articles.title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre
articles.excerpt: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.
articles.summary: 面向 CI/CD 可靠性的开源 AI agent，用于分析流水线失败、定位根因并辅助排查构建与部署问题。适合平台工程与 DevOps 团队降低流水线故障的响应成本。

articles.title: toeverything/AFFiNE
articles.excerpt: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
articles.summary: 开源一体化知识库，把文档、白板与任务规划放在同一工作区，定位为 Notion 与 Miro 的替代方案，强调隐私优先、可自托管与可定制。适合团队搭建内部协作与知识管理平台。

articles.title: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3
articles.excerpt: The only downloader you need. 下载器的集大成者。
articles.summary: 开源桌面下载器，主打多线程分片加速与现代化界面，可接管浏览器下载任务，目标是成为一站式下载工具。适合想替换 IDM 等商业下载器的普通用户。

articles.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
articles.excerpt: AutoClip｜The open-source OpusClip alternative — local-first AI clipping & MCP server, zero subscriptions. 一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。
articles.summary: 开源的 OpusClip 替代品，本地优先的 AI 视频切片工具，把播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，并生成字幕、封面与发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。
